==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Chuyi:''' Hello, anything I can help you with?
:{{DIcon}} What do you do here?
::'''Chuyi:''' This is a station of [[Huanglong]]'s inspection team in [[Dim Forest]]. We test and monitor the soil in the Forest.
::'''Chuyi:''' Dim Forest suffers continuously from the toxin spores, which is why the soil means so much to the ecosystem here.
::'''Chuyi:''' The earth breathes through the soil, so we are the pneumologists of the Forest.
:{{DIcon}} About this dog...
::'''Chuyi:''' Oh, he's my buddy. The name's Fifteenth.
::'''Chuyi:''' I adopted him on the fifteenth of the first lunar month, hence the name. Just like me, because I was born on the first of the first lunar month.
::'''Chuyi:''' Though he looks unfriendly, you need only to let him know before you pet him.
::'''Shiwu:''' Woof! Woof, woof!
{{Dialogue End}}
